html_ns_title.1: Ieon creates a new Codex or Claude session with its own work folder. It starts when you send the first question.
html_rd_title.1: Gather several AI staff in one room. The staff you call with @name replies; if you call no one, the lead replies. AI staff don't call each other on their own.

html_setup_title.1: Continue your Codex conversations on the web and in messengers. We checked what this PC needs.

html_s3.1: You can ask questions right away. The first time you send, we'll ask once whether AI may reply. The rest can wait.
html_m_title.1: Pick just one if you like. You can add others later.
html_notify_btn.1: Notify '○○ replied' when you're not viewing this tab (no content included)
html_tasks_btn.1: See each question's progress, pending approvals, and results in one place
html_mic_btn.2: Voice input (edit the dictated text before sending)
html_p_work.1: When on, an [Allow]/[Deny] card appears in the conversation whenever this conversation's Codex tries to edit files or run commands. Allow applies only this once, and it's denied if you don't answer within 15 minutes. Writing is limited to this conversation's work folder, and internet is blocked. Only conversations with a set work folder can turn this on (Settings → This PC → Allowlist).
html_wm_on.1: Matching tasks are answered "Don't do it" without asking the AI and handed to a person (the card shows what and where). If you handled it yourself, press "Done by me" to record it.
html_p_staff.1: Call them in a room with @name (no spaces). If you set a role, role instructions go along with the next question.
html_p_data.1: Deletes only this conversation's questions and answers kept on the Ieon server (this PC or hub). The original Codex or Claude session history stays. If it's processing, delete after it finishes.
html_rd_name.2: Shared instructions (this room's purpose — added before each question)
html_connect.1: Codex conversations used recently on this PC. Pick one to connect right away.
html_s0.3: The simplest. Use it on this PC's screen and via Telegram, Discord, and Slack without a public server (KakaoTalk and LINE only with a public relay)
html_s0_pc.2: You have a hub address (or a PC pairing link made on the hub). Questions, messengers, and settings are done on the hub screen
html_s0_hub.2: Sign up and use it without a public server — coming soon
html_s3.4: New sessions reply even when your PC is off
html_s3_open.2: Voice questions and read aloud use features built into this browser and device. Depending on the device, audio may pass through the device maker's servers (Google, Microsoft, Apple). The Ieon server doesn't store your voice or the dictated text. Approvals are never given by voice — only with card buttons.
html_va_title.2: When you send, this PC's Codex or Claude continues in the same conversation. Usage is deducted as you use it. You can turn it off anytime with the "AI replies" switch at the top.
